script:
# name: ca-holo-nowhere-test
# technique: test fallback (kernel-checked instances)
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicFunctions.nowhere_holomorphic
# description: conj, Re, |·|, |·|^2 are holomorphic at none of 0, 1, i; each instance proved by computation or mathlib, independently of the claim.
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['0'], 'refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
· exact (KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDerivative.conj_not_differentiableAt _).2 (Filter.Eventually.self_of_nhds h)
· exact KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDerivative.re_not_differentiableAt _ (Filter.Eventually.self_of_nhds h)
· obtain ⟨w, hw, hd⟩ := KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicFunctions.exists_ne_zero_of_eventually h
  exact KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicFunctions.abs_not_differentiableAt w hw hd
· obtain ⟨w, hw, hd⟩ := KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicFunctions.exists_ne_zero_of_eventually h
  exact hw (((KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDerivative.normSq_differentiableAt_iff w).1).1 hd)', True),
    (['1'], 'refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
· exact (KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDerivative.conj_not_differentiableAt _).2 (Filter.Eventually.self_of_nhds h)
· exact KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDerivative.re_not_differentiableAt _ (Filter.Eventually.self_of_nhds h)
· obtain ⟨w, hw, hd⟩ := KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicFunctions.exists_ne_zero_of_eventually h
  exact KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicFunctions.abs_not_differentiableAt w hw hd
· obtain ⟨w, hw, hd⟩ := KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicFunctions.exists_ne_zero_of_eventually h
  exact hw (((KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDerivative.normSq_differentiableAt_iff w).1).1 hd)', False),
    (['Complex.I'], 'refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
· exact (KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDerivative.conj_not_differentiableAt _).2 (Filter.Eventually.self_of_nhds h)
· exact KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDerivative.re_not_differentiableAt _ (Filter.Eventually.self_of_nhds h)
· obtain ⟨w, hw, hd⟩ := KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicFunctions.exists_ne_zero_of_eventually h
  exact KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicFunctions.abs_not_differentiableAt w hw hd
· obtain ⟨w, hw, hd⟩ := KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.HolomorphicFunctions.exists_ne_zero_of_eventually h
  exact hw (((KaluzaKlein.ComplexAnalysis.ComplexDerivative.normSq_differentiableAt_iff w).1).1 hd)', False),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, proof, edge in CASES]

goal.text:
¬HolomorphicAt (fun w => (starRingEnd ℂ) w) z ∧
  ¬HolomorphicAt (fun w => ↑w.re) z ∧
    ¬HolomorphicAt (fun w => ↑‖w‖) z ∧ ¬HolomorphicAt (fun w => w * (starRingEnd ℂ) w) z
